headline: AMD GPU driver bug found writing data that wears out SSDs
summary: AMD is investigating, and has admitted, a bug in its External Events Utility that generates continuous SSD writes even when Radeon-powered PCs are idle, degrading SSD health. AMD has promised a fix.

claims.statement: AMD's External Events Utility generates continuous SSD writes, even when the PC is idle, wearing out SSDs.

sources.quote: its External Events Utility generates continuous SSD writes of up to 5MB/s, even when Radeon-powered PCs are idle
AMD has admitted a bug within its External Events Utility is wearing out SSDs

claims.statement: AMD has promised a fix for the bug.
Users have reported declining SSD health, and available workarounds involve performance trade-offs.

sources.quote: Users have also reported declining SSD health, while potential workarounds come with performance trade-offs
